title: H2 Fieldwork Questions by Topic
doc: 2d H2 Fieldwork Questions by Topic v0.11.docx

sections.title: 1. What this doc is and how it was built
bullets: All H2 Paper 2 Section A fieldwork questions (Q1, 40 marks): 47 questions from 47 school-years, with 215 diagrams (197 pages, 25 MB).

Grouped under Cluster 4: Fieldwork by syllabus fieldwork area – Community response to CC (22), Fluvial flood risk (15), Elderly needs (6), Others (4) – then by school and year. The areas are the same as in doc 1.
Question wording is typed from each school's question paper; diagrams are cropped from the school's Insert.
Checks run on every question: part labels in order, marks add up to 40, and labels and marks match the reading notes (all 47 match). Every diagram was checked by eye.

sections.title: 2. Assumptions
bullets: Diagrams for a question are the resources its wording refers to, not the Insert's 'for Question N' labels. Where the question says 'Resources 2A and 2B' but the Insert prints one 'Resource 2' with both parts (TMJC 2026), that one diagram is used.

Word files (CJC, DHS, RI, RVHS, SAJC, TJC, TMJC and VJC 2026; EJC, JPJC and SAJC 2024; SAJC 2025; the HCI 2024 Insert) were converted to PDF with LibreOffice before extracting text and cropping, so line breaks and spacing can differ slightly from the printed paper.
Questionnaires that run over more than a page are split across pages at blank lines instead of being shrunk to fit one page (ACJC 2025 R2, NJC 2025 R3, NJC 2026 R3, VJC 2026 R3).
The section line is standardised to 'Section A — Cluster 4: Fieldwork' (a few schools letter their Paper 2 sections differently).
Diagrams are compressed (max 1300 px, JPEG or 256-colour PNG). Fine print in dense tables may be slightly softer than the original.

The four 'Others' questions are JPJC 2024 (cycling in Ang Mo Kio), NJC 2025 (textile recycling), NJC 2026 (e-waste) and RVHS 2026 (resource conservation in a mall). They are in doc 1's 'Others' list for your decision.

sections.title: 3. To review: text and layout
sections.note: Places where the typed text or a diagram is not a plain copy of the paper.

rows: The paper prints the mark '[10]' one character per line down the margin. The mark is entered by hand as 10 (the parts then add up to 40).
The map and photos are printed sideways in the Insert; here they are turned upright under the heading.
In the PDF made from the Word file, the table sits above its heading. Here the heading is moved back on top.
Some table cells show as solid black. This is probably from the Word-to-PDF conversion; check against the printed Insert.
The stem contains square brackets '[indicated as B1 (concrete surface) …]'; these are in the paper, not marks.

sections.title: 4. To consider
bullets: Tag each sub-part with its fieldwork stage (planning, ethics/risk, sampling, data collection, presentation, evaluation), so students can practise one stage across all schools.
Merge with doc 2a (H1 fieldwork) by fieldwork area, since both levels share the Community response to CC and Elderly needs areas.
Start each school's question on a new page for printing, and add a contents list.
